newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil weakens at close ahead of crop report.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil weakens at close ahead of crop report.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market weakened further at close with commission houses, trade selling and technical selling dominating activity. Uncertainty in soyoil and lack of demand also hit sentiment. Players were waiting for crop forecaster Ivan Wong's report on Friday. Feb futures broke the 1,200 rgt.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also followed the futures and interest focussed on nearby CPOs.
In his previous report, Wong estimated production in November to have fallen 13 percent to 770,000 tonnes. He put end-November stocks at 980,000 tonnes.
A report by the U.S. agricultural attache in Kuala Lumpur, released on Thursday, estimated that production in November fell between 10 and 15 percent over a month ago.
It put end-December stocks at 925,000 tonnes, up from the 860,000 tonnes at end-December 1995, but said the rise had no impact on the market.
Sentiment on Thursday was also hit by lack of fresh tenders and uncertainty in Chicago soyoil futures overnight.
"Technical selling also emerged when February futures broke the 1,200 level," another trader said
At the close, third month, February futures contract was 16 ringgit lower at 1,194 ringgit ($473.62) a tonne.
Inter-months spreads and commission houses amd trade sellig continue to dominate activity, traders said. Turnover was 1,609 lots against 1,853 lots on Wednesday.

Among physicals, Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,215 ringgit after trading from 1,220 and 1,215. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,212.50. Dec (central) saw offers at 1,200 and bids at 1,195, and Dec (north) at 1,190 against 1,182.50.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,222.50 and bids at 1,217.50 with earlier trades at 1,225 and 1,217.50. Feb (south) was offered at 1,225 and bids at 1,220.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $517.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $515. Dec was traded at $517.50 and $515.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $555, Jan at $550 and Feb/March at $547.50. Jan was traded at $547.50.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50 and Jan at $377.50. Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.-- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5210 ringgit)
